dedupe_keys.name: ville de soissons cycling and walking datasets

description: Ville de Soissons: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Soissons. Coverage: Ville de Soissons. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Emplacements des appuis vélo à Soissons en 2022; Emplacement des stations de gonflage et de réparation de vélos en libr; Cartographie des itinéraires cyclables de la Ville de Soissons; Cartographie des rues en double sens cyclable à Soissons. Formats seen: CSV, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
